improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the core value proposition. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for a B2B audience of business owners and traders. The copy highlights the free trial offer to reduce friction and drive conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace for your business operations. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, workspace). The subheading creates a clear call-to-action by highlighting the free trial offer without pressure. Professional tone aligns with the target audience of business owners and traders.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and full trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users—understanding what happens at the paywall. It transparently explains the transition, reinforces affordability, and highlights the value of upgrading, reducing abandonment and building trust.
